blocks.text: As Christmas parties begin filling Cebu’s December calendar, so does one familiar holiday assignment: finding a gift for the person whose name you drew for Manito-Manita. The Filipino exchange-gift tradition remains a fixture in school, office, family and barkada gatherings, turning a simple Christmas activity into a small challenge of knowing what another person might actually appreciate. For Cebuanos, the tradition is familiar precisely because it can fit almost any group. There may be a fixed budget, a weekly exchange or a playful theme such as “something red” or “something useful,” but the question remains the same: What do I give? […]...
